sentences.quote:
WalMart de Mexico y Centroamerica (Walmex) designo al chileno Cristian Barrientos Pozo como su nuevo presidente y director general (CEO).
Hasta el momento y desde el 1 de agosto de este ano, el ejecutivo se habia desempenando como lider interino y miembro del Consejo de Administracion
sentences.text: Cristian Barrientos Pozo is president and chief executive officer of Walmart de Mexico y Centroamerica (Walmex), and he also sits on the company's board, where he has been a director since 2025.

sentences.quote: La salida de Ignacio Caride el 1 de agosto de 2025 abrio la puerta a su designacion como CEO interino de Walmex, cargo que ahora se vuelve permanente.
sentences.text: Walmex confirmed his appointment after he had held the role on an interim basis since August 1, 2025, following the departure of Ignacio Caride.

A Chilean national, he began his career at Walmart Chile in 1999 in commercial and operating roles and in 2007 led the creation of the Super Bodega aCuenta discount format; he moved to Mexico in 2012 as vice president of Bodega Aurrera operations, became senior vice president in 2016 overseeing the three Bodega Aurrera formats and more than 600 store openings, ran Walmart Central America from 2018, and returned to Mexico as chief operating officer in 2020, before being named CEO of Walmart Chile in early 2023.

sentences.text: Cristian Barrientos Pozo, interim leader since August 1, 2025, was named president and CEO of Walmart de Mexico y Centroamerica on October 7, 2025, a move the company said reinforces its long-term omnichannel strategy.

The board designated Kyle Kinnard as its chairman and head of the compensation and succession planning committee, effective April 1, 2026, following the exit of Guilherme Loureiro, who ended his tenure as regional CEO on March 31, 2026.
At the parent level, Walmart International head Kathryn McLay left on January 31, 2026, with Chris Nicholas taking over from February 1, 2026.

sentences.text: Cristian Barrientos Pozo was named chief executive in October 2025 after holding the role on an interim basis, bringing more than 26 years of retail experience, most recently as CEO of Walmart Chile from early 2023.

In 2025 total revenue rose 5.5% to 1,011,598 million pesos while net income attributable to the controlling interest fell 7.3% to 49,891 million pesos, and EBITDA grew 3.4% with a 20 basis point margin contraction to 10.2%.

Capital allocation remained expansion-led: 2025 capex was guided at roughly 41.8 billion pesos, up 20% year on year, with 41% for store remodeling, 30% for new stores, 18% for supply chain and 11% for technology.

sentences.text: Walmart de Mexico y Centroamerica (Walmex) keeps gaining share in a weak consumer market: Mexico same-store sales grew 1.8% in the second quarter of 2026, outperforming ANTAD self-service by 180 basis points.

Physical expansion remains a reliable growth lever, as new stores contributed 1.6% to total sales growth and the chain opened 14 stores in Mexico and 3 in Central America in the first quarter, reaching 4,282 units.

sentences.quote: E-commerce net sales in Mexico rose 16.2%, with strong on-demand performance and improvements in delivery speed and assortment.
sentences.text: Digital is scaling fast, with eCommerce net sales in Mexico up 16.2%, strong on-demand performance and better delivery speed.
Higher-margin new businesses add an earnings stream: Bait revenues rose 40% and Walmart Connect 31% year over year, helping Mexico gross margin expand 10 basis points to 24.1%.
